hero.question: What are the top 5 best-selling genres by total sales?
hero.sql: SELECT g.Name AS Genre, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS TotalSales FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY TotalSales DESC, g.Name ASC LIMIT 5
